title: Urban teachers' street campaign and pressure measures that began before April
possible_start_range: Before April 2023; the April 10 report describes the sixth week and the April 24 report says the campaign entered its eighth week.
summary: ANF reports hundreds of teachers marched and blocked La Paz streets on April 10 during a sixth consecutive week of actions; La Razón describes the teacher conflict as entering its eighth week by April 24. This is ongoing campaign activity, not a new April onset.
continuity_status: continuation established; precise original onset and campaign endpoint unknown
limitations: Week counts are not converted into an exact onset date. Later May search-only evidence reports a February onset and May pause, but that evidence is not used to assert a precise April boundary here.
